Remark
[other classes of curves] Source: petersen:page-0198 ↗ lem:pet-ch5-constant-speed-distance ↗ rem:pet-ch5-ex-29 1. ch5:5.3.11The distance theory can equivalently be developed using absolutely continuous curves; by section 3 one could also have restricted to piecewise smooth constant-speed curves throughout.

The constant-speed assertion is section 3. The absolutely-continuous assertion belongs to the program of section 8 and is not developed here.
